en.title: Buying a Dengfu frame: a precise quote matters more than a tempting starting price
en.description: Order a Dengfu R20 or other frame directly: get an exact quote, approve substitutions, check the package and separate current terms from old owner stories.
en.intro: Dengfu’s R20 page identifies the gravel frame; it does not turn a model name into a delivered frameset package. A direct inquiry is most useful when the manufacturer answers one complete configuration.

sections.heading: Identify the exact frame on the manufacturer’s site
paragraphs: Begin at Dengfu’s [manufacturer site](https://m.dengfubikes.com/about/) and the exact [R20 product page](https://www.dengfubikes.com/Road-Frame/R20.html). The R20 page describes a customizable gravel frame but does not show a complete, destination-specific checkout. Use the site’s current contact route for a quote rather than a payment address from an old thread.

Send model and revision, size, finish, destination and intended cockpit. Request the current geometry, assembly information and all package contents. Have your assembler check the proposed interfaces; do not fill a missing R20 fact from another Dengfu frame.

sections.heading: Make substitutions opt-in
paragraphs: Ask separately whether the frame, cockpit, seatpost and frame-specific hardware are ready. If the desired cockpit is unavailable, choose among waiting, an approved alternative and cancellation under the seller’s terms. A 10 mm stem change is a fit decision, not a packing convenience.

Put this exact sentence on the confirmation: “Do not replace the frame revision, size, finish or cockpit dimensions without asking me first.” Then have the quoted parts checked together before paying.
bullets: Available now: identify physical location and the complete ready-to-ship package.
Needs production or paint: obtain a separate completion and dispatch estimate.
Proposed substitution: compare fit and price, then approve or decline in writing.

sections.heading: Use a dated order report for the questions it raises
paragraphs: A [December 2020 forum post](https://chinertown.com/index.php/topic,2.315.html) says a German buyer ordered a Dengfu R12 from China while getting a different brand’s frame from a Spanish warehouse. It documents an old route, not delivery of today’s R20, an import charge or a present-day warranty result.
For R20, ask for the current seller’s invoice, dispatch plan and support terms. An appealing owner build of another model is inspiration; the exact quote will decide whether this project is workable.

sections.heading: Ask for one invoice that answers the whole order
paragraphs: Request separate prices for the frame package, selected finish, any extra parts, shipping and the seller’s handling of import charges. Ask when production begins, when dispatch is expected and how a delay will be communicated.

Get the exact model’s warranty and damage-on-arrival process in writing, including the return destination and transport responsibility. Brand-level wording alone may leave important frame-specific details unresolved.

Have the final component list reviewed before paying, and compare the finished build cost with alternatives. The attraction of factory ordering is control over the project; clear specifications are what make that control real.

zh-Hans.title: Dengfu 车架购买指南：准确报价比起价更重要
zh-Hans.description: Dengfu R20 等车架如何直购：取得准确报价、约定替换件、核对套餐，并区分当前条款与老车主经历。
zh-Hans.intro: Dengfu 的 R20 页面能辨认砾石车架，却不能把一个型号自动变成送到家的完整车架套餐。直询厂家时，最好一次把整套配置问清。

sections.heading: 先在厂家网站确认准确车架
paragraphs: 从 Dengfu [厂家网站](https://m.dengfubikes.com/about/)和准确的 [R20 商品页](https://www.dengfubikes.com/Road-Frame/R20.html)开始。R20 页面介绍可定制的砾石车架，却没有针对目的地的完整结算报价。通过网站当前联系渠道询价，别用老帖子里的收款地址。
写清型号与版本、尺码、颜色、目的地和目标把组，索取当前几何、装配资料及全部套餐内容。请装配者检查接口；R20 缺失的规格不能拿另一款 Dengfu 车架补。

sections.heading: 替换配置必须先获得同意
paragraphs: 分别问车架、把组、座管及专用硬件是否已备好。首选把组缺货时，可以在等待、认可替代件、按条款取消之间选择。把立长度差 10 mm 是合身决定，不是装箱方便。
可在确认单写明：“未经我同意，不得替换车架版本、尺码、颜色或把组尺寸。”付款前再请装配者检查整套报价。
bullets: 已有现货：写明实物地点，以及整套可发部件。
仍需生产或喷漆：分别取得完成与发货估计。
建议替换：比较合身与价格后，书面同意或拒绝。

sections.heading: 从有日期的订购记录里提炼问题
paragraphs: [2020 年 12 月论坛帖](https://chinertown.com/index.php/topic,2.315.html)中，德国买家称 Dengfu R12 从中国订购，另一品牌车架从西班牙仓购买。这只记录老购买路径，不能证明今天 R20 的交付、进口费用或保修结果。
买 R20 时，应取得当前卖家的发票、发货安排与售后条款。另一型号的漂亮装车能提供灵感，真正决定项目是否可行的仍是准确报价。

sections.heading: 让一张报价单回答整笔订单
paragraphs: 分别列出车架套餐、所选涂装、额外配件、运费及卖家如何处理进口费用。问生产何时开始、预计何时发货，以及延误怎样通知。
书面取得具体型号保修与到货损坏流程，包括退货地点和运输责任。只有品牌层面的文字，可能仍不能解决型号相关问题。
付款前让装配者复核最终清单，再用完成后的总成本与其他方案比较。厂家订购的吸引力在于掌控项目，而明确规格才让这种掌控真正成立。
